_comment: Research log for No. 20 (Thu Oct 29 - Sun Nov 1, 2026; Halloween weekend). One entry per source in content/sources.json; every dated thing found for this Thu-Sun is a lead with a story id or a reason. Read Monday Oct 26 in the built-in browser (Instagram, logged out) and with scripts/research-sweep.mjs (websites). Vols are on a bye Saturday Oct 31 (ESPN schedule: South Carolina Oct 24, Kentucky Nov 7), so no game-day angle anywhere; the Titans are at Cincinnati Sunday at 1.

old-sevier-district.note: Oct 24 post: the Old Sevier Halloween Pub Crawl, Sat 10/31, all day, 11 stops (Alliance, Fly by Night, Hi-Wire, Honeybee, Printshop, Redbud, Sevier Ave Burger, South Coast, SouthSide Garage, Pink Cactus, Trailhead), passport at any stop, 6+ stamps enter the prize drawing, free, purchase for stamps. Oct 1 Spooky SZN carousel (images) names silent disco, haunted house parties, drag, the crawl. Site: hours and parking; ics stale.

the-808.note: Site schedule and /tm-event pages: Fri 10/30 90s Rave, doors 7 show 8, 18+, FREE ENTRY, artist Psychonaut (the Oct 20 post: 'Halloween pregame next Friday... FREE 90s rave w/ Psychonaut'); Sat 10/31 Bear Grillz, doors 7 show 8, 18+, with Spnce and Shosstah (Oct 19 post, 'Dubstep Time Machine Halloween'). Price left out: the post says $20 advance, the site says $27.55.

alliance.note: Feed: Spooky Streets campfire (Oct 22), beer reels; nothing dated Oct 29-Nov 1 of its own. It is a pub crawl stop. Site: hours Tue-Sat 12-10, Sun-Mon 12-8. Tue salsa and Wed open mic fall outside Thu-Sun.

hi-wire.note: Profile age-gated, seen 0 logged out. hiwirebrewing.simpletix.com (first-hand): Drop Dead Halloween Drag Show & Costume Contest at Hi-Wire Knoxville, Sat 10/31 9-11:30 PM, $9.55 per ticket (JSON-LD on the event page). The Oct 30 silent disco named in last week's signed-in read and the hub's Oct 1 image carousel could not be re-read first-hand this week and is left out. hiwirebrewing.com/knoxville: hours Mon-Thu 3-10, Fri 3-11, Sat 12-11, Sun 12-9.

fly-by-night.note: Oct 5 October-lineup collab post on the venue's grid: Thu 10/29 Wax Museum (@xeroxthekidd, @realcountrydark) spooky vinyl rarities; Fri 10/30 fourth annual Freaks Come Out at Night ball with Alex Falk, Minitiger, Benicio. Benicio's Oct 22 collab post: Fri 10/30, 9 PM-late, $10, 21+. Oct 20 venue post: tickets via QR/bio. Oct 25 'Halloweek' post is staff-in-costume photos. Site: hours Thu-Sat 4 PM-1 AM, Sun 2-12.

printshop.note: /specials/ dated Oct 27-31: Tue $16 pitchers, Thu 10% off cases, Fri $12 flights noon-9, Sat $1 off pints around a Vols kickoff (bye week, so moot). Feed: Oct 21 parking/detour post, Oct 25 Knox-Ill thanks; no week-ahead post yet for Oct 27-Nov 1. The Oct 30 comedy lead from last week is in no venue post and is dropped. Pub crawl stop.

trailhead.note: October flyer (Oct 1 post, read on the post page): Fri 10/30 Jake Smith Trio, Sat 10/31 Four Legged Dog, Sun 11/1 Mt Olive Pleasure Club; Fri/Sat music at 7, Sun at 4; Thu trivia 7. Gato Peligroso's Oct 20 post: Asian mushroom menu with Extraterrestrial Fungi all week through Sunday. Pub crawl stop.

pink-cactus.note: Sep 30 October list; Planet Doom's Oct 13 collab post: Fri 10/30 Love at First Laugh blind-dating gameshow 7:30 (Knox Social Club, The Comedy Sphere) then Pink Is Punk HalloweEMO party 9 PM, 18+, $35 VIP covers both, presale for the party alone at iamdoomsayer.com (9 PM-2 AM); Belltower's Sep 28 collab post: Sat 10/31 haunted house party, $15 at the gate, 18+, free karaoke in all four rooms after 9, goth DJs Verena Noctem, Sara Alured, Cemetery Sex, until 2; venue's Oct 23 reel: Sun 11/1 Dia de los Muertos 5-9, free cumbia class with Nery and Ramon, free catrina makeup, ofrenda. Free karaoke-room hour every Thursday in October (Oct 29 is the last). Site: hours Thu/Sun 5-11, Fri/Sat 5-1.
